properties.description: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_stored_item_the_schema_now_refuses_is_reported.rs. Each case writes a store under a WIDER schema (write_under_schema) and reads it under today's, narrowing one thing as a release does: REALIZES onto a Decision (the musicjug shape: finding names the endpoint_pair rule and DOCUMENTS), a removed enum value, a property made required since, a retired edge type, VERIFIES onto a Project (names what the check is evidence for, in the finding and in the import). The detector and the import refuse the same items (count and ids); an edge the import rewrites is not reported; propose_heal proposes the replacement and applies nothing (the edge survives apply_heal); two refused edges between one pair are two findings; a clean design reports none and says what it examined. Written first: 8 of the 10 original cases failed on the unfixed code (2026-10-03).
properties.name: A stored item the schema now refuses is reported, by the import's own rule
